items.title: Tuts Washington Interview, 1968-09-02
items.q: I think I was somewhere along the way he was related to him since all the way, man. I don't know.

ctx.x: I'm sure. You are not related to Steve Lewis?

I think I was somewhere along the way he was related to him since all the way, man. I don't know. I mean, you know, you have to go back to the greats, you know, grandfather, like that. They know. They can come out and talk. I mean, I don't know. I mean, people, it's a funny world, man. You might have one name now, but before you was another name, before you was another name, and then name changes as they go along, you know.
And when you wind up, man, if you look into life, man, during the day everybody almost is a lady. Yeah.
